info.title: Sigil Open Framework — Reference Implementation
info.summary: Public endpoints exposed by the SOF reference implementation at sign.sigilcore.com.
info.description:
The Sigil Open Framework (SOF) is a specification, not a hosted API. This document describes only the public, unauthenticated endpoints exposed by the SOF reference implementation at sign.sigilcore.com — useful for verifying SOF conformance, fetching the JWKS, and basic liveness checks.

Authenticated `/v1/*` endpoints (Receipts, Holds, Warranties, Stripe, Webhooks, Authorize) require a Sigil API key from https://sigilcore.com and are documented separately in the developer portal.

See https://github.com/Sigil-Core/sigil-open-framework for the full specification.

tags.name: Conformance
tags.description: Endpoints that let any client discover what SOF profile and capabilities this deployment supports, and verify the keys it signs receipts with.

get.description: Returns 200 once the reference implementation's blocking boot path (secrets, signer init, database migrations) has completed. Cloudflare Load Balancer health checks point at this path.
Returns the public keys used to verify Sigil receipt JWTs. Standard JWKS document per RFC 7517. Clients SHOULD cache and follow standard JWKS rotation rules.

keys.description: Public JWKs that this origin uses to sign receipts.

get.description: Returns this deployment's SOF conformance declaration: the framework version it claims conformance to, the profile, capability set, and a verifiable link back to the spec. Used by Sigil-aware clients to negotiate behaviour and by auditors to verify implementation claims.

schema.description: Schema is intentionally open — see https://sigilcore.com for the current SOF conformance schema.
